swing.hint: Open, the door turns around its hinge (the wall's start point, both ends for a double door) and blocks where it stands, the doorway is free. Open Direction decides the side. Drag the door icon to open it only partly.
swing.maxHint: How far the door turns at most.

swivel.hint: Open, the door turns around its middle (each half around its own middle for a double door) and blocks where it stands, the doorway beside it is free. Open Direction decides the way it turns. Drag the door icon to open it only partly.
swivel.maxHint: How far the door turns at most, up to 90.

slide.hint: Open, the door slides along its wall (towards the start point, or the end point with the reverse Open Direction; a double door opens to both ends) and blocks where it stands, the part of the doorway it left is free. Drag the door icon to open it only partly.
slide.max: Opens up to (% of its length)
slide.maxHint: How far the door slides at most. 100 frees the whole doorway.

error.not-allowed: You may not open or close doors.
error.gm-error: The gamemaster's client refused to move this door.
